title: Two Sum
problem: In an order fulfillment system, nums[i] represents the quantity of goods that can be directly picked from the i-th slot, and the order still lacks target units of the same goods. Find two different slots such that the sum of their quantities equals exactly target, and return their 0-based indices; if no such slots exist, return an empty array.
strategy: Traverse the array, use a hash table to record the indices of values that have appeared, and check for the complement.
input_contract: Input the nums array and target.
learning_objectives: Master the changing patterns of the seen mapping and the need complement value in one-pass hash table scan
Able to predict the algorithm's next operation based on the current scan position i and the seen hash table
Able to understand the efficiency improvement from hash table lookups through repeated experiments
